uTorrent Remote GUI v0.24.0
=========================

Run: utorrentgui.exe

Required folders next to the exe:
  lang\     UI translations and uTorrent setting labels
  images\   Toolbar and application icons

Settings file: utorrentgui.ini (same folder as the exe).

Requires uTorrent or BitTorrent with WebUI enabled.

Full documentation: README.md (English, copied from repo root)
Changelog:        CHANGELOG.md
Russian docs:     see repo README.ru.md when building from source
